method_notes: Weighted recent tournament form heavily, particularly knockout-round results and margin of victory. Also considered historical pedigree, squad fatigue across five matches, and head-to-head patterns where relevant.

predictions.reasoning: France have been dominant all tournament (9pts, +8 GD in group, beat Paraguay comfortably in R16) and Morocco, while impressive in beating Netherlands on penalties, have been less convincing in open play.

Spain are the only team in the tournament yet to concede a goal and dismantled Portugal 1-0 in the R16, while Belgium have been leaky (conceded in both knockout games); Spain's defensive solidity should be decisive.
Norway's upset of Brazil is credible but England have been consistent throughout and have more knockout-round pedigree; a close game but England's squad depth edges it.
Argentina have been the tournament's most prolific side and Switzerland, though resilient, scraped through on penalties against Colombia; Argentina's attacking quality should prove too much.
